description: This file defines the interface for managing command categories in a command-line or UI context, including creation, destruction, adding commands, retrieving commands, getting completions, and printing help information.
external_methods: void categoryPrint(const Category *category, bool isInteractive, bool showAdvanced)

methods.name: categoryCreate
methods.description: Creates a new command Category with the specified name and description.

methods.name: categoryDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a Category, freeing allocated resources.

methods.name: categorySetAdvanced
methods.description: Marks the Category as advanced to be shown only in advanced mode.

methods.name: categoryAddCommand
methods.description: Adds a Command to the specified Category.

methods.name: categoryGetCommand
methods.description: Retrieves a Command from the Category by name, searching both long and short names.

methods.name: categoryGetCompletions
methods.description: Provides a list of possible command completions based on a partial input.

methods.name: categoryPrint
methods.description: Prints help or info about the Category, considering interactive and display mode.
